title: In a spectral space an open subset is retrocompact iff it is quasi-compact
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] (more generally, a quasi-compact topological space in which the intersection of two quasi-compact open subsets is quasi-compact) and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subset. Then $U$ is retrocompact in $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] (that is, $U\cap W$ is quasi-compact for every quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X$) if and only if $U$ is quasi-compact.

source.place: Lemma 0069 (lemma-topology-quasi-separated-scheme, line 5470), part (2): a quasi-compact open is retrocompact; the converse and the iff are stated in the paragraph after Definition 08YG (definition-spectral-space, line 4290): 'since X is spectral an open U is retrocompact if and only if U is quasi-compact'
